study_identification_part.si4_title: Microstructural mapping of neural pathways in Alzheimer's disease using macrostructure-informed normative tractometry

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The study explicitly states its objective to propose the MINT framework to investigate white matter microstructure and macrostructure alterations in MCI and dementia, and to compare these metrics with traditional DTI metrics.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: We propose a novel macrostructure-informed normative tractometry (MINT) framework to investigate how white matter (WM) microstructure and macrostructure are jointly altered in mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and dementia. We compared MINT-derived metrics with univariate diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) metrics to examine how fiber geometry may impact the interpretation of microstructure.

nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.supporting_text: The subset of the ADNIcohort that was scanned with dMRI consisted of 447 cognitively normal(CN)participants... The NIMHANS cohort consisted of dMRI data from 123 CN participants... Bundles with fewer than 96 streamlines were removed.

nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.reason: The study uses a data partitioning strategy where the model is fine-tuned on a training set and applied to a separate test set of controls (and patients).
nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: For both the ADNI and NIMHANS datasets, data from the CN participants were split into independent subsets of size 35%/15%/50% for training/validation/testing.

nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.reason: While the study uses two cohorts (ADNI and NIMHANS), the normative model is fine-tuned specifically on the training set of each cohort before being applied to that cohort's test set. There is no application of a model developed solely on one cohort to a completely independent external cohort without fine-tuning.
nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: The pretrained VAE model was fine-tuned on 30 bundles from the subjects in the training set, in each cohort... We did not pool the training data in ADNI and NIMHANS together... to simulate the scenario where sites cannot share raw data, but can still share bundle profiles computed from their own fine-tuned model.

nm8_normative_modeling_approach.supporting_text: In our macrostructure-informed normative tractometry (MINT) framework, a key component is the VAE model... MINT, we use 1D convolutional layers... Code and the pretrained model are available at https://github.com/wendyfyx/MINT.

nm9_model_performance_reference_cohort.supporting_text: The reconstruction error describes how well a new sample fits the distribution of the training data and can serve as a normative baseline... We expected the reconstruction error to be higher for data with abnormalities.
